# Vancouver Childcare Plan for Oct 19–23, 2026

A weekday childcare booking for **2 children (ages 4 and 7)** from **8:00 AM to 5:30 PM** is best handled as a short list of daycare, before/after-school, and licensed drop-in programs. With a **CAD 300 total budget**, the most realistic fit is usually **part-time drop-in care, community centre programs, or sibling-discounted camps/holiday care** if available.

## Childcare Options to Compare

| Option | Best fit | Typical fit for your needs | Budget fit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Licensed drop-in daycare | Flexible days, short notice | Often indoor-focused; some have playtime | Possible if daily rates are low |
| Community centre day program | School-age and mixed-age care | More likely to include outdoor play | Good chance of sibling discounts |
| Licensed daycare with casual care | Structured care, reliable staffing | Allergy policies usually clearer | May exceed budget quickly |
| Holiday / pro-d day camp | Ages 4 and 7 together sometimes | Strong outdoor play and snacks | Best chance if weekly pricing is offered |
| Recreation / childcare cooperative | Lower-cost local option | Varies by site and schedule | Often strongest budget match |

## Best-Fit Checklist for Your Booking

- **Dates needed:** Monday to Friday, **2026-10-19 to 2026-10-23**
- **Daily hours:** **8:00 AM–5:30 PM**
- **Children:** **2 siblings, ages 4 and 7**
- **Top priorities:** outdoor play, allergy-aware snacks, sibling discount
- **Budget target:** **CAD 300 total**
- **Budget test to use:** ask for the **full weekly total including registration, snack fees, and taxes**
- **Must confirm:** whether both children can attend the same program and whether age groups are combined
- **Must confirm:** outdoor access every day, rain plan, and snack ingredient handling
- **Must confirm:** whether food is provided or must be packed from home
- **Must confirm:** sibling discount, multi-day discount, or weekly rate
- **Must confirm:** pick-up window, late fees, and sick-day policy

## Booking Comparison Checklist

| Checkpoint | What to ask | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| Age fit | Can a 4-year-old and 7-year-old attend together? | Avoids splitting siblings across programs |
| Schedule fit | Is care available all five weekdays, 8:00 AM–5:30 PM? | Confirms full coverage |
| Outdoor play | How much outdoor time is included each day? | Matches your preference |
| Allergy handling | Are snacks nut-aware and allergy-aware? | Important for safety |
| Food policy | Are snacks included or packed from home? | Affects total cost and planning |
| Sibling discount | Is there a reduced rate for two children? | Helps stay within budget |
| Weekly pricing | Is there a week package or day bundle? | Best way to compare cost |
| Cancellation rules | What happens if one child misses a day? | Protects your budget |
| Licensing | Is the program licensed in BC? | Helps verify standards and oversight |
| Transport | Is drop-off/pick-up easy by transit or car? | Practical for weekday scheduling |

## Message Template to Request Availability

**Subject:** Childcare availability request for 2 children in Vancouver, Oct 19–23, 2026

Hello,

I’m looking for childcare in Vancouver for **two children ages 4 and 7** from **Monday, Oct 19 through Friday, Oct 23, 2026**.

We need care each weekday from **8:00 AM to 5:30 PM**. Our priorities are:
- Outdoor play time
- Allergy-aware snack handling
- Sibling discount or family rate
- A total budget of **CAD 300**

Could you please let me know:
- Whether you have availability for both children
- Your daily and weekly rates
- Whether snacks are included
- Your allergy policy
- Whether outdoor play is part of the schedule
- Any sibling discount or multi-day discount
- Registration steps and deposit requirements

Thank you, and I’d appreciate any details you can share.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Phone Number]

## Quick Actions

- City of Vancouver community centres: https://vancouver.ca/parks-recreation-culture/community-centres.aspx
- Vancouver School Board before/after school care: https://www.vsb.bc.ca/parents/child-care/Pages/default.aspx
